Download a file, fill it in, save it under the given name next to the original. The pipeline then reports accuracy against it.

Gold setLemmatisation (300 forms)


Equal numbers per final label, half from cases the models agreed on and half from adjudicated ones, shuffled. Definitions of the labels are in the second tab of the file (in Polish).


Source file: zloty_zbior_do_oznaczenia.xlsx (view · download).








NoteColumn glossary












Column
Meaning




id
Item identifier.


kandydat
Candidate to be labelled.


liczba_wyrazow
Number of words.


wystapienia_biologia
Occurrences in the biology sample.


wystapienia_inne_przedmioty
Occurrences in the other subjects of the sample.


liczba_innych_przedmiotow
Number of other subjects in which the candidate occurs.


zdanie_1
Sentence from the corpus containing the candidate.


zdanie_2
Second sentence, from a different material where possible.


zdanie_3
Third sentence.


kategoria_oceniajacy_A
To be filled in by annotator A.


kategoria_oceniajacy_B
To be filled in by annotator B.


forma_poprawna_jesli_inna
To be filled in only if the base form of the candidate is wrong.


uwagi
Annotator notes.

G001świetlny12395[Biologia] rośliny zielone, a także niektóre gatunki pierwotniaków i bakterii, wiążące energię świetlną lub chemiczną i wytwarzające z pobieranych związków nieorganicznych substancje organiczne[Biologia] Zastanów się, do jakich procesów wykorzystywana jest energia świetlna.[Biologia] W jego soczewkowatych komórkach załamują się promienie świetlne, co powoduje powstanie złoto - szmaragdowej poświaty.
G002przebywać114328[Biologia] Wiele osób chroni przyrodę, aby móc podziwiać jej piękno i przebywać w jej otoczeniu, wśród zieleni i śpiewu ptaków.[Biologia] Zmierzono czas, jaki kęs pokarmu przebywa w organizmie człowieka.[Biologia] U mieszkańca nizin, który dłuższy czas przebywa w wysokich górach, wzrasta ilość czerwonych ciałek krwi.
G003głowotułów11300[Biologia] głowa, tułów (lub głowotułów) i odwłok; członowane odnóża, pokrycie ciała chitynowym pancerzem, u owadów skrzydła[Biologia] tylna część ciała stawonogów połączona z tułowiem lub głowotułowiem; w przypadku pajęczaków i owadów zawiera większość narządów
G004pomoc języka2053[Informatyka] Zapis algorytmu za pomocą języka Python[Geografia] Porozumiewają się za pomocą języka złożonego z co najmniej 30 dźwięków.[Język polski] Porozumiewanie się za pomocą języka jest jednym ze sposobów informowania.
G005choroba układu oddechowego31700[Biologia] Informacje niezbędne do rozwiązania zadania znajdziesz w e - materiale pt. Profilaktyka chorób układu oddechowego.[Biologia] Istnieje wiele dowodów naukowych na to, że palenie zwiększa ryzyko wielu poważnych chorób, w tym nowotworów, chorób układu krążenia i przewlekłych chorób układu oddechowego.
G006alergiczny1300[Biologia] Na przykład: miły – niemiły, alergiczny – antyalergiczny, moralny – amoralny.[Biologia] unikanie kontaktu z alergenami (przy katarze alergicznym) i chorymi, przestrzeganie podstawowych zasad higieny[Biologia] Śmierć człowieka może nastąpić także wskutek użądlenia pszczoły, osy lub szerszenia, jeżeli u uczulonej osoby rozwinie się ciężka reakcja alergiczna.
G007rybik cukrowy2300[Biologia] Jednym ze zwierząt, które potrafi samodzielnie strawić celulozę, jest rybik cukrowy.[Biologia] fotografie owadów: muchy domowej, pszczoły miodnej, pluskwiaka różnoskrzydłego, konika polnego, komara tygrysiego i rybika cukrowego.
G008wierzchołek11525[Plastyka] Fale cudownego słonecznego światła zalały poszycie puszczy, a nad głowami, między wierzchołkami drzew, zajaśniało błękitne niebo.[Matematyka] Odległość między wierzchołkami E i F ostrosłupów wynosi czterdzieści cm.[Język polski] Kiedy skakał, ręką chwytał wierzchołek największego smreka.
G009symbolika10134[Historia] Wyjaśnij, do jakiego elementu symboliki chrześcijańskiej odwoływał się podział na trzy stany społeczne i dlaczego.[Język polski] Dowody fascynacji ludzi tymi pięknymi i groźnymi zwierzętami odnajdujemy nie tylko w licznych opracowaniach naukowych, ale także w tekstach literackich oraz bogatej symbolice i frazeologii.[Plastyka] Artysta przypisywał kolorom duchową, mistyczną symbolikę.
G010lis rudy2500[Biologia] — Pewnie był to lis rudy, zwany pospolitym.[Biologia] Wskaż cechy lisa rudego i fenka pustynnego będące ich przystosowaniem do zmieniających się warunków środowiska.
G011narząd rozrodczy2500[Biologia] USG narządów rozrodczych i piersi, 2. badanie cytologiczne, 3. samodzielne badanie piersi – umożliwia wykrycie zakażeń bakteryjnych dróg rodnych oraz raka szyjki macicy we wczesnym rozwoju[Biologia] USG narządów rozrodczych i piersi, 2. badanie cytologiczne, 3. samodzielne badanie piersi – umożliwia obserwację narządów wewnętrznych i wykrycie w nich nieprawidłowości w budowie lub obecność guzów
G012wyładowanie1083[Edukacja dla bezpieczeństwa] Pioruny, czyli silne wyładowania elektryczne, które towarzyszą burzom, występują z różnym nasileniem w większości regionów świata.[Fizyka] Warto jednak pamiętać, że w niektórych warunkach powietrze może przewodzić prąd elektryczny (np. podczas wyładowań atmosferycznych).[Plastyka] Na całym świecie, w tym samym czasie, ma miejsce około 1800 burz i około 100 wyładowań w ciągu jednej sekundy.
G013zakładać112011[Wiedza o społeczeństwie] Bezcenne torfowiska w dolinie Rospudy stwarzały dobre warunki dla kilkudziesięciu gatunków roślin i ptaków objętych ochroną: swoje gniazda zakładały tam bieliki, bociany czarne i dzięcioły białogrzbiete.[Fizyka] Pamiętajmy jednak, że zakładamy stałą wartość przyspieszenia grawitacyjnego.[Język polski] Razi nas forma Witam, ponieważ zakłada ona – jak słusznie Pani zauważa – wyższą rangę osoby, która tej formy używa.
G014podział administracyjny2053[Historia] Powstał wówczas (1775) podział administracyjny, który przetrwał do XIX w. i obok zmian w edukacji (oraz oczywiście nabytków terytorialnych) był najtrwalszym elementem rządów Katarzyny II.[Geografia] Są to kolejno: obszar łańcucha Himalajskiego zaznaczono jego granice na niebiesko, podział administracyjny granice państw zaznaczono na czarno, nazwy państw.[Plastyka] 1999 – wprowadzenie obecnie obowiązującego, trójstopniowego podziału administracyjnego Polski.
G015produkt trawienia2600[Biologia] Zastanów się do którego z narządów, jako pierwszego trafia krew z produktami trawienia z jelita cienkiego?[Biologia] Końcowym produktem trawienia białek są aminokwasy.
G016mapa przedstawiająca2054[Geografia] W czasie przeglądania atlasu Polski z pewnością nie raz zdarzyło Ci się natrafić na mapę przedstawiającą rozmieszczenie ludności.[Historia] Ilustracja to mapa przedstawiająca okolice Żnina.[Historia] Zasób zawiera krótki wstęp, kolorową mapę przedstawiającą Polskę pod dwiema okupacjami oraz dwa ćwiczenie interaktywne: polecenia związane z pracą z mapą i tekstem źródłowym: Skąd pochodzą poszczególne osoby?
G017nasiono rzeżuchy2300[Biologia] Widoczne są: dwa pudełka, sześć probówek, nożyk, lignina, nasiona rzeżuchy, woda, zegar, pisak, termometr.
G018allel12500[Biologia] ślepota barw; zaburzenie widzenia warunkowane genetycznie przez recesywny allel znajdujący się na chromosomie X; jego efektem jest nierozpoznawanie barwy czerwonej i zielonej[Biologia] Hemofilia i daltonizm uwarunkowane są allelem recesywnym, dlatego kobiety chorują rzadziej, gdyż mają dwie kopie genu sprzężonego z chromosomem X.
G019właściwość fizyczna20144[Chemia] Wszystkie substancje mają pewne charakterystyczne właściwości, które dzielimy na właściwości fizyczne oraz chemiczne.[Geografia] gr. klíma ‘ nachylenie ’, ‘ szerokość geograficzna ’], charakterystyczny dla danego obszaru zespół zjawisk i procesów atmosferycznych (warunków pogodowych), kształtujący się pod wpływem właściwości fizycznych i geograficznych tego obszaru, określony na podstawie wyników wieloletnich obserwacji i pomiarów meteorologicznych
G020bok ciała2300[Biologia] 9 – Linia naboczna to narząd zmysłu ułożony wzdłuż boków ciała ryby.[Biologia] Powietrze dostaje się do nich przez przetchlinki – niewielkie otwory rozmieszczone po bokach ciała, a następnie wędruje nimi do wnętrza zwierzęcia.
G021prędkość122359[Edukacja dla bezpieczeństwa] Aby w przybliżeniu określić odległość wyładowania od miejsca, w którym znajduje się obserwator, należy pomnożyć prędkość dźwięku, czyli ok. 340 m / s przez liczbę sekund, jaka upłynęła od błysku do grzmotu.[Przyroda] Wyjaśnisz, jak wyznaczyć kierunek i prędkość przepływu wody w rzece.[Matematyka] Im dłużej jedziemy z ustaloną prędkością, tym dłuższą przebywamy drogę.
G022nakładać1196[Historia] [...] oprócz zwykłych danin jeszcze trzy albo cztery razy w roku, ilekroć zechcą, grabią ich majątki, dręczą niezliczonymi powinnościami, nakładają ciężary ogromne i nieznośne.[Informatyka] Zazwyczaj aplikacje te nie nakładają na użytkownika obowiązku rejestracji.[Plastyka] Artysta nakłada kolory grubą warstwą, szybkimi, nagłymi, przerywanymi pociągnięciami pędzla.
G023piątek12362[Biologia] Piątek z zafrasowaną miną szedł przez las, pchając przed sobą dziecięcy wózeczek.[Biologia] Piątek nieraz srożył się, wypisywał mandaty, apelował do sumień i uczciwości…[Matematyka] 1100 W rozkładzie tej liczby występują dokładnie trzy dwójki i trzy piątki.
G024ciśnienie117626[Biologia] paliwa powstałe w wyniku beztlenowych procesów zachodzących pod ogromnym ciśnieniem we wnętrzu Ziemi;[Biologia] Gdzie jest większe ciśnienie atmosferyczne – na nizinach, czy w górach?[Biologia] przewód łączący jamę bębenkową z gardłem; odpowiada za wyrównywanie różnicy ciśnień między uchem zewnętrznym i środkowym
G025krążek międzykręgowy2400[Biologia] Trzony kręgów łączą się ze sobą za pomocą krążków międzykręgowych.[Biologia] Krzywizny kręgosłupa wraz ze znajdującymi się pomiędzy kręgami krążkami międzykręgowymi (nazywanymi potocznie dyskami) amortyzują wstrząsy i obciążenia, którym poddawany jest organizm podczas wykonywania codziennych czynności.
(375 more rows not shown)






Fill in lemat_poprawny_czlowiek and pos_poprawny_czlowiek.


Source file: ocena_lematyzacji_300.xlsx (view · download).








NoteColumn glossary












Column
Meaning




id
Item identifier.


warstwa
Matching stratum: part of speech for single words, fraza 2 / fraza 3 for multiword items.


zrodlo_referencji
Where the reference lemma comes from: ZPE editors (redakcja ZPE) or provisional (Opus).


forma
Inflected form as found in the text.


kontekst
Sentence from the ZPE material containing the form.


lemat_ref
Reference base form used for scoring.


pos_ref_tymczasowy_opus
Provisional part of speech proposed by Claude Opus 5.5.


lemat_poprawny_czlowiek
To be filled in by the human checker.


pos_poprawny_czlowiek
To be filled in by the human checker.


uwagi
Annotator notes.


material_id
ZPE material identifier.


lemat_ref_tymczasowy_opus
Provisional reference proposed by Claude Opus 5.5 (to be checked by a human).


llm_haiku_5_5_lemat
Base form from Claude Haiku 5.5.


llm_haiku_5_5_pos
Part of speech from Claude Haiku 5.5.


llm_sonnet_5_5_lemat
Base form from Claude Sonnet 5.5.


llm_sonnet_5_5_pos
Part of speech from Claude Sonnet 5.5.


llm_haiku_5_5_ok
1 if the base form from Claude Haiku 5.5 equals the reference.


llm_sonnet_5_5_ok
1 if the base form from Claude Sonnet 5.5 equals the reference.


spacy_lemat
Base form from spaCy alone.


spacy_pos
Part of speech from spaCy alone.


spacy_morfeusz_lemat
Base form from spaCy + Morfeusz2 (production).


spacy_morfeusz_pos
Part of speech from spaCy + Morfeusz2 (production).


stanza_lemat
Base form from Stanza alone.


stanza_pos
Part of speech from Stanza alone.


stanza_morfeusz_lemat
Base form from Stanza + Morfeusz2.


stanza_morfeusz_pos
Part of speech from Stanza + Morfeusz2.


morfeusz_pierwsza_lemat
Base form from Morfeusz2, first reading.


morfeusz_pierwsza_pos
Part of speech from Morfeusz2, first reading.

TermoPL8.1.1readyBSD 2-clause (Copyright (c) 2016, Institute of Computer Science, Polish Academy of Sciences)https://zil.ipipan.waw.pl/TermoPLcd resources/tools/termopl && ./run_termopl.sh TXT_DIR WORK_DIR OUT_TSV 4   |   direct: cd resources/tools/termopl/TermoPL_Mac_OS_X && java -Djava.awt.headless=true -Xmx1500M -jar TermoPL.jar -SW -CP -CT -method gt -srch npmi3 -cntx 1 -save "# rank sf bf cvalue length freq_s freq_in context" -exp /abs/path/terms_all.tsv /abs/path/dir_with_conllu_filesInstalled from TermoPL_Mac_OS_X.zip (9,429,888 bytes, arm64 JNI libs) to resources/tools/termopl/TermoPL_Mac_OS_X (21 MB). Input must be tagged and lemmatised: .conllu (FORM, LEMMA, XPOS as NKJP-style tag; UPOS/HEAD/DEPREL only for -method ud) or flat 'form<TAB>lemma<TAB>tag' with empty line between sentences. Stanza CoNLL-U output is read as is (txt2conllu.py). No batch option for maximum term length: filter the exported 'length' column (run_termopl.sh does it). Must be started from its own directory, otherwise UnsatisfiedLinkError with exit status 0 and wrong output. Plain-text input does not work in batch mode (-python is ignored in 8.1.1). Directory arguments are read recursively and must contain only input files. Test: 402 tokens, 0.32 s, 127 terms.
Morfeusz2 (Python module in main venv; also bundled in TermoPL)1.99.15, dictionary pl.sgjp.sgjp-2026.06.01readyBSD 2-clause (program and SGJP data)https://morfeusz.sgjp.pl/. .venv/bin/activate && python -c "import morfeusz2; print(morfeusz2.Morfeusz().analyse('błonę'))"Was already installed; not changed. Gives all readings without disambiguation, so it cannot feed TermoPL alone. Used here to correct Stanza lemmas (txt2conllu.py --morfeusz-lemmas) and as the analyser in front of Concraft-pl (concraft/concraft_tag.py).
spaCy pl_core_news_lg3.8.0licence_unclearGNU GPL 3.0 (meta.json of the package)https://github.com/explosion/spacy-models/releases/download/pl_core_news_lg-3.8.0/pl_core_news_lg-3.8.0-py3-none-any.whl. .venv/bin/activate && python -c "import spacy; nlp = spacy.load('pl_core_news_lg'); print([(t.text, t.lemma_, t.tag_, str(t.morph)) for t in nlp('Błona komórkowa oddziela wnętrze komórki.')])"Installed and working in the main venv with 'python -m spacy download pl_core_news_lg' (wheel 573.7 MB, 611 MB on disk, 81 s); spacy validate reports it compatible with spaCy 3.8.18. LICENCE FLAG: the package declares GNU GPL 3.0 and lists its source 'UD Polish PDB v2.8' as GNU GPL 3.0, but UD_Polish-PDB states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 since release v2.4 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Polish-PDB/master/LICENSE.txt). GPL 3.0 is copyleft. token.tag_ holds only the NKJP class (SUBST, ADJ); termopl/spacy2flat.py rebuilds a full tag from token.morph for TermoPL. pip left a copy of the wheel in ~/Library/Caches/pip (573,718,074 bytes).

pl_nask (spaCy transformer pipeline, Ryszard Tuora, ICS PAS)0.0.7not_installablenot stated in package metadata (meta.json license field is empty); a GPL v3 text LICENSE.txt is in the same download directoryhttps://mozart.ipipan.waw.pl/~rtuora/spacy/meta.json: spacy_version '>=3.5.0,<3.6.0', requirements ['spacy-transformers>=1.1.5,<1.2.0']. Conflicts with spaCy 3.8.18 in the main venv; spaCy 3.5.4 has no cp312 wheel (cp36-cp311 only).Not installed (453 MB archive). LICENCE FLAG: no explicit licence for the model. Not attempted: spaCy 3.5.4 has macOS arm64 wheels for Python 3.10/3.11, so a separate conda environment might work.
Stanza Polish models (default package: UD_Polish-PDB + NKJP NER)resources 1.15.0 for Stanza 1.15.0: tokenize pdb_nocharlm, mwt pdb, pos pdb_charlm, lemma pdb_nocharlm, depparse pdb_charlm, ner nkjplicence_unclearApache-2.0 (model card); Stanza code Apache-2.0https://huggingface.co/stanfordnlp/stanza-pl. .venv/bin/activate && python -c "import stanza; nlp = stanza.Pipeline('pl', dir='resources/tools/stanza_resources', processors='tokenize,mwt,pos,lemma', download_method=None, use_gpu=False); print([(w.text, w.lemma, w.xpos) for s in nlp('Fotosynteza zachodzi w chloroplastach.').sentences for w in s.words])"Installed and working: stanza.download('pl', model_dir='resources/tools/stanza_resources') (416 MB zip, deleted after unpacking; 436 MB on disk; 25 s). Load 1.8 s, one sentence 0.08 s on CPU. XPOS is the NKJP-style tag TermoPL expects. LICENCE FLAG: model card says Apache-2.0, but the training treebank UD_Polish-PDB is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 since v2.4 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Polish-PDB/master/LICENSE.txt); Stanza docs say UD models use UD v2.12. Lemmatiser errors on domain words (dwutlenek -> dwutlenka, błonę -> błońa, fotosyntezy -> fotosyntez); use txt2conllu.py --morfeusz-lemmas. The download also left a copy of default.zip in ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/blobs/16/162b914981fee565eeda4a379678d7e24fd1a01e3ed48cf956349363eb9105c4 (416,036,108 bytes).

Model 84,150,136 bytes. About 5 s per file, mostly model loading. Input DAG is produced from Morfeusz2 (expand_tags=True); output is converted to TermoPL flat format. Concraft does not lemmatise: 2 of 402 test segments had several lemmas marked disamb. LICENCE FLAG: no licence given for the model file. No pip package (PyPI concraft-pl and concraft-pl2 return 404); building from source needs the Haskell Tool Stack (not attempted).

Self-hosting was not examined.

Access via the lpmn_client_biz Python library or LPMN CLI tool (https://wiki.clarin-pl.eu/pl/nlpservices/lpmn-client). COMBO (combo-nlp)4.0.14 (with combo-seg 0.1.6); model clarin-pl/combo-nlp-xlm-roberta-base-polish-pdb-ud2.17needs_decisioncode: GPL-3.0; Polish parsing and segmentation models: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; base encoder FacebookAI/xlm-roberta-base: MIThttps://pypi.org/project/combo-nlp/Models are not on disk: the first run downloads 3.36 GB into resources/tools/combo/hf_cache.cd resources/tools/combo && . venv/bin/activate && export HF_HOME=$PWD/hf_cache WANDB_MODE=disabled TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false && python -c "from combo import COMBO; nlp = COMBO.from_pretrained('clarin-pl/combo-nlp-xlm-roberta-base-polish-pdb-ud2.17'); print([(t.form, t.lemma, t.xpos) for s in nlp('Dwutlenek węgla przenika przez błonę komórkową.') for t in s])"Installed in its own venv (pip install --no-cache-dir combo-nlp==4.0.14, 47 s, 1.0 GB) and verified on Python 3.12 arm64: first load 80.9 s including downloads, two sentences 6.1 s on CPU; XPOS is NKJP-style. The model cache (three files of about 1.1 GB each) was deleted afterwards because it took total downloads to about 5 GB, over the 4 GB budget. Three things that did not go as instructed

Download budget exceeded. Total downloads were about 5 GB against the ~4 GB limit. The overshoot comes from COMBO: 205 MB of wheels plus 3.36 GB of models (I had expected about 1.1 GB; the segmenter model and the base encoder are a further 1.1 GB each). The 3.36 GB model cache has been deleted again; the 1.0 GB venv is kept. rm -rf resources/tools/combo removes the rest.
Two archive copies were written outside resources/tools/ by the mandated download commands (library defaults, noticed afterwards, left untouched because they sit in your personal caches):

~/.cache/huggingface/hub/blobs/16/162b914981fee565eeda4a379678d7e24fd1a01e3ed48cf956349363eb9105c4 (416,036,108 bytes, Stanza default.zip), plus the small ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--stanfordnlp--stanza-pl/ entry that points to it. Stanza 1.15.0 downloads through huggingface_hub, which caches there regardless of model_dir.
~/Library/Caches/pip/http-v2/6/b/f/7/a/6bf7a2b408c3b3cb9e4a423e0c004cb23aa2b9b143d351354224e7c1.body (573,718,074 bytes, the pl_core_news_lg wheel in pip’s HTTP cache). Both are safe to delete; together they hold about 1 GB.

pyarrow==26.0.1 appeared in the main venv at 12:32:37. It was not installed by this work (the only pip action here was python -m spacy download pl_core_news_lg at 12:26). spacy, stanza, torch, numpy and pandas are unchanged (pip freeze diff before/after shows only pl_core_news_lg and pyarrow).

All downloaded archives inside resources/tools/ were deleted after unpacking (TermoPL_Mac_OS_X.zip, Stanza pl/default.zip, Concraft-MacOSX.zip, format-examples.zip).




2. TermoPL 8.1.1

Page: https://zil.ipipan.waw.pl/TermoPL (“Downloads (current version: 8.1.1)”, page last edited 2025-10-30). The jar’s About class contains the string Version 8.1.1.
Downloaded: https://zil.ipipan.waw.pl/TermoPL?action=AttachFile&do=get&target=TermoPL_Mac_OS_X.zip (9,429,888 bytes, “Mac OS X (arm_64)” package), unpacked to termopl/TermoPL_Mac_OS_X/. SHA-256 of TermoPL.jar: b46c5aab9a9dfa70ffc1ba51e180c4473201100edb8ccddd59ae562f768c6fb2.
Package contents: TermoPL.jar, libjmorfeusz.dylib and libmorfeusz2.dylib (both arm64), parse.py, TermoPL-user-manual.pdf (manual “TermoPL 8.1”, dated 22.09.2025), termopl_sw.txt / termopl_cp.txt / termopl_ct.txt (default stop words, compound prepositions, common terms), languages/.
Licence: BSD 2-clause, “Copyright (c) 2016, Institute of Computer Science, Polish Academy of Sciences”. Text: termopl/LICENSE.txt, from https://zil.ipipan.waw.pl/TermoPL?action=AttachFile&do=get&target=LICENSE.txt. The bundled Morfeusz 2 library is also BSD 2-clause (https://morfeusz.sgjp.pl/doc/license/).
Sources (src.zip from the same page) were read to confirm the behaviour described below; they are not kept on disk.


2.1 Input formats (manual section 2.1 and CorpusReader.java)
TermoPL needs morphologically tagged, disambiguated, lemmatised UTF-8 input. The format is chosen per file:








Format
Recognised by
What is read




CoNLL-U
extension .conllu
col 2 FORM, col 3 LEMMA, col 4 UPOS, col 5 XPOS (used as the NKJP-style tag), col 6 FEATS, col 7 HEAD, col 8 DEPREL, col 10 MISC (SpaceAfter=No, or start_char=..\|end_char=.., optional ner=). Multi-word-token lines 1-2 are handled. A comment line containing newdoc starts a new document. All 10 columns must be present.


Flat text
any other name whose lines have two tabs
form<TAB>lemma<TAB>tag, or form<TAB>#lemma<TAB>#tag#. Empty line (or &<TAB>&<TAB>interp) ends a sentence. A line starting with %% starts a new document.


Legacy flat
extension .tgt
form<TAB>lemma<TAB>tag[<TAB>nps], sentences end with a line eos.


XCES / CCL
extension .ccl or <?xml … <cesAna
<tok><orth>, <lex disamb="1"><base>, <ctag>


NKJP TEI
<?xml … <teiCorpus
ann_morphosyntax-style fs type="morph" with disamb


Plain text
anything else
handed to parse.py (Stanza) to produce a .conllu next to the file. Does not work in batch mode in 8.1.1, see 2.4.



The tag is the NKJP/SGJP positional tag with : separators, e.g. subst:sg:gen:m3, adj:pl:nom:f:pos. The built-in grammar only looks at the class (subst, ger, adj, adja, ppas), at case = gen, at agreement in number/case/gender, and at the form -. The default tagset is defined “by values”, so the order of categories inside the tag does not matter.

There is no option for maximum term length. Bad option: -maxlen is what an invented option returns. A min/max length filter exists only in the GUI’s Terms window (Preferences.minLength = 2, maxLength = -1, applied only together with “multi-word terms only”). The cap therefore has to be applied to the exported table using the length column. Longer phrases are still found and still count as contexts for their nested sub-phrases, which is how C-value is meant to work.
C-value as implemented (manual 3.1): C(p) = l(p) * (f(p) - (1/|LP|) * sum f(lp)) if p is nested in other phrases, else l(p) * f(p); l(p) = log2(length) for multi-word terms and 0.1 for one-word terms.

2.4 Pitfalls found while testing

Start it from TermoPL_Mac_OS_X/. libjmorfeusz.dylib loads libmorfeusz2.dylib by bare name, which macOS resolves against the current directory. From any other directory (with or without -Djava.library.path=<app dir>) you get java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError: no jmorfeusz in java.library.path, exit status 0, and an output file with wrong content (rank 0, unsorted, different C-values). -sf (simplified forms only) fails the same way from another directory. Always check stderr.
Plain-text input does not work in batch mode. -python PATH is parsed but never passed on (BatchParameters.python is not referenced by any other class in the 8.1.1 jar; checked with javap). Result: Python interpreted not selected., exit status 0, empty output. Workaround: tag first, pass .conllu. This is also preferable because the bundled parse.py calls stanza.download() on every run.
A directory argument is read recursively and every file in it is used, including .DS_Store or leftover .txt files. An unrecognised file triggers pitfall 2 and the whole run yields an empty output. Keep the input directory clean (only .conllu).
Wildcards are not expanded by the program (File does not exist -- …/*.conllu followed by a NullPointerException). Give a directory, or let the shell expand the pattern (do not quote it).
Row order among ties is not stable between a directory argument and a shell-expanded file list (same rows, same values, different order inside a rank). Repeated runs with the same argument are byte-identical. Sort downstream by C-value and term if a stable order is needed.
~/.TermoPL-8: if the GUI is ever started it saves its preferences there, and batch mode loads that file first. It does not exist on this machine. Settings that batch mode does not override (for example the min/max length used with -mw) would then come from the GUI.
Stanza lemmatises gerunds as nouns (oddychanie), Morfeusz/Concraft/spaCy as infinitives (oddychać). TermoPL prints the right base form in both cases, but mixing the conventions in one corpus splits terms. txt2conllu.py --morfeusz-lemmas therefore never touches gerunds.



2.5 Batch run on a directory of text files with a 4-word cap
cd resources/tools/termopl
./run_termopl.sh /path/to/txt_dir /path/to/work_dir /path/to/terms_max4.tsv 4
# optional 5th argument: contrastive term set (.trm or text export), adds comp_ll
Verified on the test corpus: 3.8 s wall in total, output all terms: 127  kept (length <= 4): 127. The script tags with Stanza (--no-depparse --morfeusz-lemmas), runs the command from 2.3 from inside TermoPL_Mac_OS_X/, fails loudly if stderr contains an exception or the output is empty, then keeps rows with length <= 4, strips the brackets from the base form and adds a header (nr rank simplified_form base_form cvalue length freq_s freq_in contexts). It also writes work_dir/terms.trm (reusable as a contrastive set for another run) and work_dir/terms_all.tsv (unfiltered).
The filter itself, if you run TermoPL by hand with the -save list above (length is column 6, or column 7 when -comp is used):
awk -F'\t' '$6 <= 4' terms_all.tsv > terms_max4.tsv
Memory: the manual states about 1 GB of RAM per 500,000 tokens and suggests -Xmx5G -Xms4G for much larger corpora. Not measured here.

SHA-256: binary a2fbe4afa051230b06658c09bafff269c81b9138f7fb8e49a54a5eedab903ceb, model 55cbdd4a42705210201eba00d1dfdb1f74038e33bfdb1f07a92b94bd180837fe. The page says this model is “for Morfeusz 1.99.5 (2022/02/20) and newer”; the venv has Morfeusz 1.99.15 with dictionary pl.sgjp.sgjp-2026.06.01.
Licence: Concraft-pl code BSD 2-clause, “Copyright (c) 2013 Jakub Waszczuk” (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kawu/concraft-pl/master/LICENSE). The page states no licence for the model file (“trained on NKJP1M-SGJP … financed by CLARIN-PL”), and no licence for the prebuilt binaries beyond that of the source.
Working pipeline (main venv python; Morfeusz2 analysis, Concraft disambiguation, flat file for TermoPL):
cd resources/tools/concraft
. ../../../.venv/bin/activate
python concraft_tag.py ../termopl/test/txt test/work test/flat
biologia_01.txt: 163 tokens, concraft 5.9s
biologia_02.txt: 239 tokens, concraft 4.1s
10 s in total; almost all of it is loading the model once per file (the binary also has a server mode that loads it once; not tested). The tagging command inside the script is ./concraft-pl tag concraft-pl-model-SGJP-20220221.gz -i X.dag -o X.tagged.dag.
Input DAG format (one line per Morfeusz interpretation, 11 tab-separated columns, blank line after each paragraph): start node, end node, form, lemma, tag, commonness, qualifiers, probability (0.0), interpretation meta, eos, segment meta. The output adds the probability, eos in column 10 at sentence ends, and disamb in column 12 on the chosen interpretation. Example from the test run:
4   5   w   w   prep:acc:nwok           0.0000
4   5   w   w   prep:loc:nwok           1.0000              disamb
Concraft does not lemmatise: when several lemmas share the chosen tag, all are marked disamb (2 of 402 segments here: Ściana:Sf/ściana, stężeć/stężyć). concraft_tag.py takes the first lemma that starts with a lower-case letter.
TermoPL on the Concraft output (concraft/test/out/terms_concraft.txt, 128 rows) gives the same top 12 rows as the Stanza-based run. One difference further down: różnica stężeć gazy [różnica stężeń gazów], where Concraft chose a gerund reading for “stężeń”.



6. COMBO and KRNNT (optional)

6.1 COMBO
Two different packages exist:

Legacy COMBO 1.0.7 (https://gitlab.clarin-pl.eu/syntactic-tools/combo, master branch setup.py; mirror https://github.com/ipipan/combo, last push 2021-01-20, GPL-3.0). Pins allennlp==1.3.0, torch==1.7.1, spacy==2.3.2, transformers==4.0.1, numpy==1.22.0, scipy==1.6.0, scikit-learn==0.23.2. Not installable on Python 3.12 arm64; not attempted.
combo-nlp 4.0.14 on PyPI (uploaded 2026-10-18; requires_python >=3.10; licence expression GPL-3.0; homepage https://gitlab.clarin-pl.eu/syntactic-tools/combo-nlp). Requires torch>=2.0.0, transformers>=4.35.0, peft, wandb, accelerate, combo-seg>=0.1.1 and others. Installed in a separate venv and run.

/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3 -m venv resources/tools/combo/venv
. resources/tools/combo/venv/bin/activate
pip install --no-cache-dir combo-nlp==4.0.14      # 47 s, 205 MB of wheels, venv 1.0 GB
Installed among others: torch-2.15.0, transformers-5.22.2, numpy-2.5.4, combo-seg-0.1.6, wandb-0.31.0 (which pulls cwevals-0.0.1b1, the CoreWeave Evaluations API client). The main venv was not touched.
Smoke test:
cd resources/tools/combo && . venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=$PWD/hf_cache HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 WANDB_MODE=disabled TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
python - <<'EOF'
from combo import COMBO
nlp = COMBO.from_pretrained("clarin-pl/combo-nlp-xlm-roberta-base-polish-pdb-ud2.17")
for sentence in nlp("Fotosynteza zachodzi w chloroplastach komórek roślinnych, gdzie chlorofil pochłania światło. Dwutlenek węgla przenika przez błonę komórkową."):
    for token in sentence:
        print(token.form, token.lemma, token.upos, token.xpos, token.head, token.deprel, sep='\t')
EOF

6.2 KRNNT
https://github.com/kwrobel-nlp/krnnt (last push 2023-05-22, LGPL-3.0, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kwrobel-nlp/krnnt/master/LICENSE). Not on PyPI (https://pypi.org/pypi/krnnt/json returns 404). Not installed. Reasons:

setup.py (version 1.0.0) pins Keras==2.2.5 and, as extras, tensorflow==1.14.0 / tensorflow-gpu==1.12.0; requirements.txt pins numpy==1.16.4, h5py==2.9.0.
TensorFlow 1.14.0 on PyPI has wheels only for cp27 and cp33–cp37, on macosx_10_11_x86_64, manylinux1_x86_64, win_amd64. Nothing for Python 3.12 or arm64. h5py 2.9.0 stops at cp38, x86_64.
It also needs the external tools Maca and Toki (maca-analyse -qc morfeusz2-nkjp), which the README tells you to install by following a Dockerfile.
The README’s supported route is Docker (docker run -p 9003:9003 -it djstrong/krnnt:1.0.0); no Docker daemon here.

Trained models are attached to the GitHub releases (reana.zip 20 MB, preana.zip 21 MB, reana10.zip 146 MB); no separate model licence is stated in the README.




7. Licence flags (for a decision by the project owner)

UD_Polish-PDB is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Its LICENSE.txt and README (https://github.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Polish-PDB) say so, and the README changelog records “License changed from GNU GPL 3.0 to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0” at release v2.4 (2019-05-15). All three neural pipelines’ Polish models are trained on it:

spaCy pl_core_news_lg 3.8.0 declares itself GNU GPL 3.0 and lists “UD Polish PDB v2.8” with licence “GNU GPL 3.0”. That does not match the treebank’s own statement for v2.4 and later.
Stanza’s stanza-pl model card declares Apache-2.0. The Stanza documentation page says the UD models are trained on Universal Dependencies v2.12, a release in which PDB is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
COMBO’s model card says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, consistent with the treebank. Whether a model inherits the licence of its training data is a legal question that this check does not answer.

Concraft-pl model concraft-pl-model-SGJP-20220221.gz: no licence stated on the download page.
pl_nask: no licence in the package metadata.
GPL 3.0 (spaCy model, IPI PAN spaCy models, COMBO code) and LGPL 3.0 (KRNNT) are copyleft licences; relevant if tools or models are redistributed.
TermoPL, Morfeusz2 with SGJP, and the Concraft-pl code are BSD 2-clause. Outputs of TermoPL (term lists) are not covered by any statement on the TermoPL page.

What is downloadable today:

Format: TSV, UTF-8, LF, header row, sorted by descending frequency. Each file sums to 1,215,513.
How the counts are made:

The unit counted is one NKJP segment (<seg>). Punctuation is its own segment, and so are agglutinates such as em in zrobiłem.
The lemma and class are the manually disambiguated ones: the choice pointer in <f name="disamb"> is resolved to its <fs type="lex"> (base, ctag). All 1,215,513 segments resolved this way.
Lemma case is kept as annotated, so proper names are capitalised. orth_lc is the segment lower-cased.
Nothing is filtered: punctuation, numbers and foreign strings are included. The only normalisation is trimming and collapsing whitespace inside a segment’s form and lemma, needed because one URL segment contains a TAB.
In the NKJP tagset verb forms belong to separate classes (fin, praet, inf, ger, ppas, …), so one verb is spread over several rows of the lemma × ctag file; the lemma-only file sums them, and also merges homonyms of different classes.

Where it is today:

3. KWJP (Korpus Współczesnego Języka Polskiego, dekada 2011–2020)
A downloadable frequency list exists.

https://kwjp.pl/lists/ is an online browser of the frequency lists. Its help page https://kwjp.pl/lists/doc/about/ ends with “Listy frekwencyjne KWJP można również pobrać z repozytorium”, linking to https://github.com/ipipan/kwjp100-varia/tree/main/freqlists.
That repository holds 48 gzipped CSV lists: words and 2/3/4-grams × {lemma, orth, orth_lc} × {all, fakt, fikcja, publicystyka}. The three single-word lists for the whole balanced corpus were downloaded. The genre-specific word lists (2.4–6.5 MB each) and the n-gram lists were not.
CLARIN-PL repository: a search for “KWJP” through https://clarin-pl.eu/dspace/server/api/discover/search/objects?query=KWJP returned 0 results (the old https://clarin-pl.eu/dspace/discover?query=KWJP URL returns 404).

Licence: the repository README.md says “Ze wszystkich zasobów zamieszczonych w tym repozytorium można korzystać na zasadach licencji CC-BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0)” — https://github.com/ipipan/kwjp100-varia/blob/main/README.md. There is no separate LICENSE file.
Corpus (stated at https://kwjp.pl/overview): texts from 2011–2020; “over one billion words, 100 million of which have been included in the balanced corpus”, made up of 35% news and journalistic texts, 30% fiction and 35% non-fiction. It has no spoken or internet texts. The requested citation is Kieraś et al., Język Polski 105(2):5–20, 2025, doi 10.31286/JP.001055.
How the lists were built (stated on the help page): compiled automatically from the balanced corpus using automatic lemmatisation and tagging, so they may contain errors; only words in Latin letters (optionally with a hyphen); only units occurring at least 5 times in the whole corpus.

4. wordfreq 3.1.1 (Python library, already in the venv)
Nothing was downloaded. Facts below come from the installed package (wordfreq-3.1.1.dist-info/METADATA, which embeds the README) and were cross-checked against https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq/blob/master/README.md.

It runs: wordfreq.word_frequency('fotosynteza', 'pl') returns 1.74e-07 (Zipf 2.24).
Sources for Polish (README table row Polish pl 6 Yes │ Yes Yes Yes - Yes Yes Yes -): six domains from the “Exquisite Corpus” project.

Wikipedia
Subtitles: “OPUS OpenSubtitles 2018 and SUBTLEX”. The SUBTLEX lists the README names are US, UK, CH, DE and NL; SUBTLEX-PL is not among them.
News: NewsCrawl 2014 and GlobalVoices
Web: OSCAR
Twitter
Reddit
Not used for Polish: Google Books.

How they are combined: per word, the sources giving the highest and lowest frequency are dropped, the rest averaged, and the list rescaled to sum to 1. There is therefore no single corpus size.
Unit: orthographic forms, not lemmas. Text is tokenised with a regex tokenizer following Unicode UAX #29 and case-folded: Proces and proces return the same value, and tokenize('Fotosynteza i KOMÓRKA', 'pl') gives ['fotosynteza', 'i', 'komórka']. Inflected forms have their own entries (komórka 5.25e-06, komórki 2.95e-05).
Resolution: frequencies are stored in bins of 0.01 on the Zipf scale. Polish has a “large” list (used by default as best; 453,320 entries, down to Zipf 1.0) and a “small” one. Multi-digit numbers are pooled by shape.
Licence: code Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt); the README says it “includes data files that may be redistributed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license”. See https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq#license.

title: Pools and concepts
text:
What
In this run




Subject pool
candidates labelled T3 (biology term)
789, of which 306 multiword


General pool
candidates labelled T1 (everyday) or T2 (school vocabulary)
3188: 1480 T1, 1708 T2


Matching
one general word per term: same part of speech, closest in general frequency and length
514 terms have a partner


Concepts
terms that name the same thing (variants, synonyms, a noun and its adjective)
636, of which 122 group several terms





How the pools are built: Method. Labels come from language models; rows with do_przegladu = True had no majority. Filter with the boxes under the header, click a header to sort, Columns shows hidden columns.

Subject pool (T3)General pool (T1/T2)ConceptsTerms the extraction missed




Source file: pula_przedmiotowa.csv (view · download).








NoteColumn glossary












Column
Meaning




forma_podstawowa
Base (dictionary) form of the item. Equal to forma_kandydata unless the models corrected a wrong base form (same number of words only).


pojecie
Concept the term belongs to. Terms that are variants, synonyms or derivatives of one concept share the label; a term without a group is its own concept.


obrazowalnosc
Model judgement whether the concept can be shown in a picture or diagram (tak, czesciowo, nie).


dopasowanie_ogolne
General-pool item matched to this term (same stratum, closest frequency and length); empty if no item lies within the calipers.


dopasowanie_delta_zipf
Zipf frequency of the term minus that of its match.


dopasowanie_delta_liter
Letters of the term minus letters of its match.


dlugosc
Number of words.


pos
Part of speech used for matching: rzeczownik noun, przymiotnik adjective, czasownik verb, przysłówek adverb, fraza multiword, inne other.


n_liter
Letters in forma_podstawowa, spaces not counted.


zipf_dopasowania
Frequency used for matching: zipf_kwjp for single words, zipf_zpe for phrases.


forma_kandydata
The candidate exactly as extracted in step 4. All counts, scores and ranks in the row were computed for this string.


lematy
Lemmas of the candidate’s words, in order (the key used to count occurrences).


cls
Inflectional class of the lemma from Morfeusz2 (subst noun, adj adjective, ger gerund, ppas/pact participles, fin/inf/praet verb forms, adv adverb); mwu for multiword candidates.


kand_przedmiotowy
Candidate from the target corpus (passed the subject thresholds).


kand_ogolny
Candidate from the whole stage corpus, spread over several contrast subjects (source of T1/T2 items).


freq_cel
Occurrences in the target corpus (biology).


freq_kontrast
Occurrences in the contrast corpus (other subjects of the same school stage).


n_mat_cel
Number of target materials containing the candidate.


n_mat_kontrast
Number of contrast materials containing the candidate.


n_przedmiotow
Number of contrast subjects in which the candidate occurs (dispersion).


n_klas_cel
Number of distinct estimated grades among target materials containing the candidate.


udzial_nazw_wlasnych
Share of occurrences tagged as a proper name.


freq_kwjp
Lemma frequency in KWJP100 (general Polish, CC BY 4.0), summed over inflectional classes; gerunds and participles are counted from the verb’s entry. Empty for multiword candidates.


zipf_kwjp
Zipf frequency in KWJP100: log₁₀ of occurrences per billion words (single words only).


zipf_wordfreq
Zipf frequency from wordfreq (0 = not found; single words only).


zipf_zpe
Zipf frequency in the whole stage corpus of ZPE (target + contrast); available for multiword candidates too.


ll_vs_kontrast
Log-likelihood keyness, target vs contrast corpus; negative when relatively rarer in biology.


log_ratio_kontrast
Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs contrast (smoothing 0.5).


ll_vs_kwjp
Log-likelihood keyness against KWJP100 (single words).


log_ratio_kwjp
Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs KWJP100 (single words).


simple_maths_kwjp
Kilgarriff’s Simple Maths keyness against KWJP100 (per-million rates, N = 1; single words).


tfidf_biol
Relative frequency in biology × log(1 + subjects / (1 + n_przedmiotow)).


rozproszenie
Same value as n_przedmiotow (higher = more cross-subject).


pmi
Multiword candidates: lowest pointwise mutual information among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.


logdice
Multiword candidates: lowest logDice among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.


cvalue
TermoPL C-value on the target corpus (empty = not returned by TermoPL).


termopl_ok
Whether TermoPL ran successfully in this run.


rank_ll_vs_kontrast
Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kontrast (1 = best).


rank_log_ratio_kontrast
Rank of the candidate by log_ratio_kontrast (1 = best).


rank_simple_maths_kwjp
Rank of the candidate by simple_maths_kwjp (1 = best).


rank_ll_vs_kwjp
Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kwjp (1 = best).


rank_tfidf_biol
Rank of the candidate by tfidf_biol (1 = best).


rank_pmi
Rank of the candidate by pmi (1 = best).


rank_logdice
Rank of the candidate by logdice (1 = best).


rank_cvalue
Rank of the candidate by cvalue (1 = best).


rrf
Reciprocal-rank fusion of the method rankings (higher = ranked high by several methods).


rank_rrf
Rank of the candidate by rrf (1 = best).


etykieta_regulowa
Rule-based pre-label from dispersion and frequency thresholds (T3?, T2?, T1?, nierozstrzygniete). Kept for comparison only; not shown to the models and not used for the pools.


srebrny_slowniczek
True if the candidate is an entry of a ZPE glossary in the target materials.


srebrny_pojecie_ref
True if the candidate is a base form written by ZPE editors for a linked term.


kategoria_final
Same as kategoria, empty when the candidate was not sent to the models.


typ_szumu
For SZUM: fragment_terminu part of a longer term, luzne_polaczenie free word combination, nazwa_wlasna proper name, blad_ekstrakcji extraction error, interfejs platform interface or instruction text, inne other; brak for all other labels.


pelny_termin
For fragments of a term: the full term the fragment belongs to, as given by the model.


zgodnosc_glosow
How many of the votes carry the final label (for example 2 z 2, 2 z 3).


do_przegladu
True if no label had a majority among the models, or the adjudicator itself reported low confidence.


model_sedzia
Adjudicating model, where the case was adjudicated.


sonnet_5_5_kategoria
Label from Claude Sonnet 5.5.


sonnet_5_5_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).


sonnet_5_5_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (in Polish).


opus_5_5_kategoria
Label from Claude Opus 5.5.


opus_5_5_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of Claude Opus 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).


opus_5_5_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by Claude Opus 5.5 (in Polish).


sedzia_kategoria
Label from the adjudicating model.


sedzia_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of the adjudicating model (wysoka, srednia, niska).


sedzia_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by the adjudicating model (in Polish).


kategoria
Final label from step 5: T3 biology term, T3_INNY term of another school subject, T2 school / academic vocabulary, T1 everyday vocabulary, SZUM not usable as a test item; nieklasyfikowany = not sent to the models (in neither pool).


duplikat_formy
Filled when another row has the same forma_podstawowa after correction and is the main row for it (this row is then left out of the pools).


freq_cel_laczna
Occurrences in the target corpus summed over all warianty.


freq_kontrast_laczna
Occurrences in the contrast corpus summed over all warianty.


warianty
All candidate strings that name this item after correction (for example odwłok; odwłoka, one lemma split by a tagging error).


warstwa
Matching stratum: part of speech for single words, fraza 2 / fraza 3 for multiword items.

NoteColumn glossary












Column
Meaning




forma_podstawowa
Base (dictionary) form of the item. Equal to forma_kandydata unless the models corrected a wrong base form (same number of words only).


kategoria
Final label from step 5: T3 biology term, T3_INNY term of another school subject, T2 school / academic vocabulary, T1 everyday vocabulary, SZUM not usable as a test item; nieklasyfikowany = not sent to the models (in neither pool).


dopasowanie_przedmiotowe
Subject term this general-pool item is matched to.


dlugosc
Number of words.


pos
Part of speech used for matching: rzeczownik noun, przymiotnik adjective, czasownik verb, przysłówek adverb, fraza multiword, inne other.


n_liter
Letters in forma_podstawowa, spaces not counted.


zipf_dopasowania
Frequency used for matching: zipf_kwjp for single words, zipf_zpe for phrases.


forma_kandydata
The candidate exactly as extracted in step 4. All counts, scores and ranks in the row were computed for this string.


lematy
Lemmas of the candidate’s words, in order (the key used to count occurrences).


cls
Inflectional class of the lemma from Morfeusz2 (subst noun, adj adjective, ger gerund, ppas/pact participles, fin/inf/praet verb forms, adv adverb); mwu for multiword candidates.


kand_przedmiotowy
Candidate from the target corpus (passed the subject thresholds).


kand_ogolny
Candidate from the whole stage corpus, spread over several contrast subjects (source of T1/T2 items).


freq_cel
Occurrences in the target corpus (biology).


freq_kontrast
Occurrences in the contrast corpus (other subjects of the same school stage).


n_mat_cel
Number of target materials containing the candidate.


n_mat_kontrast
Number of contrast materials containing the candidate.


n_przedmiotow
Number of contrast subjects in which the candidate occurs (dispersion).


n_klas_cel
Number of distinct estimated grades among target materials containing the candidate.


udzial_nazw_wlasnych
Share of occurrences tagged as a proper name.


freq_kwjp
Lemma frequency in KWJP100 (general Polish, CC BY 4.0), summed over inflectional classes; gerunds and participles are counted from the verb’s entry. Empty for multiword candidates.


zipf_kwjp
Zipf frequency in KWJP100: log₁₀ of occurrences per billion words (single words only).


zipf_wordfreq
Zipf frequency from wordfreq (0 = not found; single words only).


zipf_zpe
Zipf frequency in the whole stage corpus of ZPE (target + contrast); available for multiword candidates too.


ll_vs_kontrast
Log-likelihood keyness, target vs contrast corpus; negative when relatively rarer in biology.


log_ratio_kontrast
Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs contrast (smoothing 0.5).


ll_vs_kwjp
Log-likelihood keyness against KWJP100 (single words).


log_ratio_kwjp
Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs KWJP100 (single words).


simple_maths_kwjp
Kilgarriff’s Simple Maths keyness against KWJP100 (per-million rates, N = 1; single words).


tfidf_biol
Relative frequency in biology × log(1 + subjects / (1 + n_przedmiotow)).


rozproszenie
Same value as n_przedmiotow (higher = more cross-subject).


pmi
Multiword candidates: lowest pointwise mutual information among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.


logdice
Multiword candidates: lowest logDice among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.


cvalue
TermoPL C-value on the target corpus (empty = not returned by TermoPL).


termopl_ok
Whether TermoPL ran successfully in this run.


rank_ll_vs_kontrast
Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kontrast (1 = best).


rank_log_ratio_kontrast
Rank of the candidate by log_ratio_kontrast (1 = best).


rank_simple_maths_kwjp
Rank of the candidate by simple_maths_kwjp (1 = best).


rank_ll_vs_kwjp
Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kwjp (1 = best).


rank_tfidf_biol
Rank of the candidate by tfidf_biol (1 = best).


rank_pmi
Rank of the candidate by pmi (1 = best).


rank_logdice
Rank of the candidate by logdice (1 = best).


rank_cvalue
Rank of the candidate by cvalue (1 = best).


rrf
Reciprocal-rank fusion of the method rankings (higher = ranked high by several methods).


rank_rrf
Rank of the candidate by rrf (1 = best).


etykieta_regulowa
Rule-based pre-label from dispersion and frequency thresholds (T3?, T2?, T1?, nierozstrzygniete). Kept for comparison only; not shown to the models and not used for the pools.


srebrny_slowniczek
True if the candidate is an entry of a ZPE glossary in the target materials.


srebrny_pojecie_ref
True if the candidate is a base form written by ZPE editors for a linked term.


kategoria_final
Same as kategoria, empty when the candidate was not sent to the models.


typ_szumu
For SZUM: fragment_terminu part of a longer term, luzne_polaczenie free word combination, nazwa_wlasna proper name, blad_ekstrakcji extraction error, interfejs platform interface or instruction text, inne other; brak for all other labels.


pelny_termin
For fragments of a term: the full term the fragment belongs to, as given by the model.


obrazowalnosc
Model judgement whether the concept can be shown in a picture or diagram (tak, czesciowo, nie).


zgodnosc_glosow
How many of the votes carry the final label (for example 2 z 2, 2 z 3).


do_przegladu
True if no label had a majority among the models, or the adjudicator itself reported low confidence.


model_sedzia
Adjudicating model, where the case was adjudicated.


sonnet_5_5_kategoria
Label from Claude Sonnet 5.5.


sonnet_5_5_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).


sonnet_5_5_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (in Polish).


opus_5_5_kategoria
Label from Claude Opus 5.5.


opus_5_5_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of Claude Opus 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).


opus_5_5_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by Claude Opus 5.5 (in Polish).


sedzia_kategoria
Label from the adjudicating model.


sedzia_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of the adjudicating model (wysoka, srednia, niska).


sedzia_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by the adjudicating model (in Polish).


duplikat_formy
Filled when another row has the same forma_podstawowa after correction and is the main row for it (this row is then left out of the pools).


freq_cel_laczna
Occurrences in the target corpus summed over all warianty.


freq_kontrast_laczna
Occurrences in the contrast corpus summed over all warianty.


warianty
All candidate strings that name this item after correction (for example odwłok; odwłoka, one lemma split by a tagging error).


warstwa
Matching stratum: part of speech for single words, fraza 2 / fraza 3 for multiword items.

title: Method
text:
Models










Task
Model
Step




Label every candidate, twice and independently
Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5
5


Settle disagreements and low-confidence cases
Fable 5.2
5


Group terms into concepts
Fable 5.2
5


List terms directly from the materials (check on step 4)
Opus 5.5
5

Opus 5.5
7

Fable 5.2
7

Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5
2





All requests go through the Claude Batch API (anthropic 2.8.0) with JSON-schema output.

title: Method
text:
1 · Corpus
Why: subject words stand out only against the text of other subjects.










What
How
Tool




Target
materials of the subject Biologia, school stage E2
ZPE dump


Contrast
materials of all other subjects of the same stage, without foreign languages; six per target material in a sample run
ZPE dump


Text
HTML parsed into titles, body, definitions, exercises, captions
lxml 6.1.3


Cleaning
sentences repeated in at least 25 materials, interface instructions and licence lines are removed
own rules

title: Method
text:
2 · Tagging and lemmatisation
Why: Polish inflects, so counting words needs their base forms.










What
How
Tool




Lemma and part of speech
spaCy tags each token; the Morfeusz2 reading that agrees with spaCy gives the lemma
spacy 3.8.18 (pl_core_news_lg), morfeusz2 1.99.15


Check
300 forms, mostly rare terms and phrases; spaCy and Stanza, each with and without Morfeusz2, Morfeusz2 alone, Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
stanza 1.15.0

title: Method
text:
3 · Frequencies
Why: general frequency tells a rare term from an everyday word, and it is what matching uses later.










What
How
Resource




Used in the lists
KWJP100 lemma frequencies, on the Zipf scale
KWJP100 (CC BY 4.0)


Compared only
coverage of the biology vocabulary and agreement with KWJP100
NKJP, SUBTLEX-PL, wordfreq 3.1.1

title: Method
text:
4 · Candidates
Why: a complete and repeatable list of everything that could be a term, made before any model is involved.










What
How
Tool




Single words
lemmas of content words known to Morfeusz2; proper names dropped
own code


Phrases
noun phrases of 2–4 words found by syntactic patterns (adjective + noun, noun + genitive), rebuilt in the nominative
own code (frazy.py)


Subject candidates
at least 3 occurrences in at least 2 biology materials, or at least 5 in one



General candidates
at least 5 occurrences across at least 3 other subjects



Scores
log-likelihood and log ratio against the contrast corpus and against KWJP100, Simple Maths, TF-IDF across subjects, PMI and logDice for phrases, C-value, rank fusion of all of them
own code; C-value from TermoPL 8.1.1





The scores rank candidates and are compared with each other on the Results page. They do not decide the labels: all subject candidates (up to 4000) and a stratified sample of 1500 general candidates go to the models.

title: Method
text:
5 · Labels
Why: statistics cannot tell a biology term from a school word that happens to be frequent in biology.









What
How




The model sees
the candidate, its counts in biology and in the other subjects, up to three sentences from the corpus


The model returns
a label, a corrected base form if needed, whether the term can be shown in a picture, its confidence, a one-sentence reason


Labels
T3 biology term · T3_INNY term of another subject · T2 school vocabulary · T1 everyday word · SZUM not usable


Final label
the label of Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 if they agree and are confident; otherwise Fable 5.2 votes too and the majority of three decides; no majority → marked for review


Concepts
Fable 5.2 groups variants, synonyms and derivatives of one concept, in one request over all T3 terms

title: Method
text:
6 · Pools
Why: the test compares terms with general words, so the two sets must not differ in frequency or length.










What
How
Tool




Subject pool
all candidates labelled T3



General pool
all candidates labelled T1 or T2



Matching
one general word per term: same part of speech, closest Zipf frequency and length; optimal assignment without reuse, within 1 Zipf and 3 letters
scipy 1.18.1 (linear_sum_assignment)


Worksheet
400 candidates, stratified by label, for two annotators; model labels are not shown
openpyxl 3.1.5

title: Method
text:
7 · Pseudowords
Why: the word-recognition test needs non-words that look and sound Polish and cannot be spotted by their shape.
Each pseudoword is tied to a template: one of 240 real nouns and verbs drawn from the two pools. Each generator gives up to 12 candidates per template.










Generator
How
Tool or model




wuggy_koncowka
replaces sub-syllabic segments of the template, keeps their lengths and the template’s ending
Wuggy 1.1.2, Polish plugin


wuggy
the same, ending free
Wuggy 1.1.2


unipseudo
letter-trigram chain built from real words of the same length and part of speech
UniPseudo (Python port), WorldLex-Polish


llm
the model is given the template and asked for non-words with the same ending and number of syllables
Opus 5.5


imbir
published list, items accepted by at least 4 of 5 judges, paired by length
Imbir et al. (2015)





Hard filters; a candidate is rejected by the first one it fails:









Filter
Rule




Existing word
found in Morfeusz2, KWJP100, WorldLex, wordfreq or the corpus


Shape
length within one letter of the template, same number of syllables, same kind of ending


Letter patterns
every trigram, onset, coda and consonant cluster occurs in at least 5 of 64 293 Polish lemmas


Too close to a word
one edit from the template or from a frequent word (Zipf ≥ 3), or sounds like a word


Transparent
a real stem with a prefix or suffix, or two words joined


Unsuitable
vulgar association; sounds like one of 54 295 frequent Ukrainian or Russian words





Edit distances: rapidfuzz 3.14.6.









What
How




Ranking
within a template, by closeness to it in neighbourhood density (OLD20) and bigram probability


Rating
Fable 5.2 rates the top 6 per template, at most half from one generator: pronounceability 1–5, similarity to a real word 0–3, and flags for existing, foreign and inappropriate


Recommended list
pronounceability ≥ 4, similarity ≤ 1, no flag; the best-ranked 2 per template


Check
templates and pseudowords compared on length, syllables, clusters, diacritics, OLD20, bigram probability

NoteColumn glossary












Column
Meaning




forma_podstawowa
Base (dictionary) form of the item. Equal to forma_kandydata unless the models corrected a wrong base form (same number of words only).


forma_kandydata
The candidate exactly as extracted in step 4. All counts, scores and ranks in the row were computed for this string.


form_changed



kategoria
Final label from step 5: T3 biology term, T3_INNY term of another school subject, T2 school / academic vocabulary, T1 everyday vocabulary, SZUM not usable as a test item; nieklasyfikowany = not sent to the models (in neither pool).


typ_szumu
For SZUM: fragment_terminu part of a longer term, luzne_polaczenie free word combination, nazwa_wlasna proper name, blad_ekstrakcji extraction error, interfejs platform interface or instruction text, inne other; brak for all other labels.


pelny_termin
For fragments of a term: the full term the fragment belongs to, as given by the model.


pojecie
Concept the term belongs to. Terms that are variants, synonyms or derivatives of one concept share the label; a term without a group is its own concept.


obrazowalnosc
Model judgement whether the concept can be shown in a picture or diagram (tak, czesciowo, nie).


do_przegladu
True if no label had a majority among the models, or the adjudicator itself reported low confidence.


zgodnosc_glosow
How many of the votes carry the final label (for example 2 z 2, 2 z 3).


kand_przedmiotowy
Candidate from the target corpus (passed the subject thresholds).


kand_ogolny
Candidate from the whole stage corpus, spread over several contrast subjects (source of T1/T2 items).


dlugosc
Number of words.


pos
Part of speech used for matching: rzeczownik noun, przymiotnik adjective, czasownik verb, przysłówek adverb, fraza multiword, inne other.


freq_cel
Occurrences in the target corpus (biology).


freq_kontrast
Occurrences in the contrast corpus (other subjects of the same school stage).


n_mat_cel
Number of target materials containing the candidate.


n_przedmiotow
Number of contrast subjects in which the candidate occurs (dispersion).


zipf_kwjp
Zipf frequency in KWJP100: log₁₀ of occurrences per billion words (single words only).


zipf_zpe
Zipf frequency in the whole stage corpus of ZPE (target + contrast); available for multiword candidates too.


duplikat_formy
Filled when another row has the same forma_podstawowa after correction and is the main row for it (this row is then left out of the pools).


cls
Inflectional class of the lemma from Morfeusz2 (subst noun, adj adjective, ger gerund, ppas/pact participles, fin/inf/praet verb forms, adv adverb); mwu for multiword candidates.


lematy
Lemmas of the candidate’s words, in order (the key used to count occurrences).


n_mat_kontrast
Number of contrast materials containing the candidate.


n_klas_cel
Number of distinct estimated grades among target materials containing the candidate.


udzial_nazw_wlasnych
Share of occurrences tagged as a proper name.


freq_kwjp
Lemma frequency in KWJP100 (general Polish, CC BY 4.0), summed over inflectional classes; gerunds and participles are counted from the verb’s entry. Empty for multiword candidates.


zipf_wordfreq
Zipf frequency from wordfreq (0 = not found; single words only).


ll_vs_kontrast
Log-likelihood keyness, target vs contrast corpus; negative when relatively rarer in biology.


log_ratio_kontrast
Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs contrast (smoothing 0.5).


ll_vs_kwjp
Log-likelihood keyness against KWJP100 (single words).


log_ratio_kwjp
Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs KWJP100 (single words).


simple_maths_kwjp
Kilgarriff’s Simple Maths keyness against KWJP100 (per-million rates, N = 1; single words).


tfidf_biol
Relative frequency in biology × log(1 + subjects / (1 + n_przedmiotow)).


rozproszenie
Same value as n_przedmiotow (higher = more cross-subject).


pmi
Multiword candidates: lowest pointwise mutual information among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.


logdice
Multiword candidates: lowest logDice among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.


cvalue
TermoPL C-value on the target corpus (empty = not returned by TermoPL).


termopl_ok
Whether TermoPL ran successfully in this run.


rank_ll_vs_kontrast
Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kontrast (1 = best).


rank_log_ratio_kontrast
Rank of the candidate by log_ratio_kontrast (1 = best).


rank_simple_maths_kwjp
Rank of the candidate by simple_maths_kwjp (1 = best).


rank_ll_vs_kwjp
Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kwjp (1 = best).


rank_tfidf_biol
Rank of the candidate by tfidf_biol (1 = best).


rank_pmi
Rank of the candidate by pmi (1 = best).


rank_logdice
Rank of the candidate by logdice (1 = best).


rank_cvalue
Rank of the candidate by cvalue (1 = best).


rrf
Reciprocal-rank fusion of the method rankings (higher = ranked high by several methods).


rank_rrf
Rank of the candidate by rrf (1 = best).


etykieta_regulowa
Rule-based pre-label from dispersion and frequency thresholds (T3?, T2?, T1?, nierozstrzygniete). Kept for comparison only; not shown to the models and not used for the pools.


srebrny_slowniczek
True if the candidate is an entry of a ZPE glossary in the target materials.


srebrny_pojecie_ref
True if the candidate is a base form written by ZPE editors for a linked term.


kategoria_final
Same as kategoria, empty when the candidate was not sent to the models.


model_sedzia
Adjudicating model, where the case was adjudicated.


sonnet_5_5_kategoria
Label from Claude Sonnet 5.5.


sonnet_5_5_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).


sonnet_5_5_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (in Polish).


opus_5_5_kategoria
Label from Claude Opus 5.5.


opus_5_5_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of Claude Opus 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).


opus_5_5_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by Claude Opus 5.5 (in Polish).


sedzia_kategoria
Label from the adjudicating model.


sedzia_pewnosc
Self-reported confidence of the adjudicating model (wysoka, srednia, niska).


sedzia_uzasadnienie
One-sentence reason given by the adjudicating model (in Polish).


freq_cel_laczna
Occurrences in the target corpus summed over all warianty.


freq_kontrast_laczna

title: JUTRO pilot: subject vocabulary and pseudowords
text:
WarningStatus



Candidate lists, built automatically from a sample of 50 biology materials. They are proposals: which items enter the test is for subject and language experts to decide.

title: JUTRO pilot: subject vocabulary and pseudowords
text:
Goal
A pupil with a migration background can fail a biology test because of weak Polish or because of missing biology concepts. The JUTRO test is meant to tell the two apart. This pilot builds the word material for it from the teaching materials of the ZPE platform.

title: JUTRO pilot: subject vocabulary and pseudowords
text:
What it produces





Output
What it is for
In this run




Subject pool
biology terms, to test subject concepts
789 terms in 636 concepts


General pool
everyday and school words, to test general Polish; each term gets a partner of similar frequency and length
3188 words; partner found for 514 terms (65%)


Pseudowords
non-words for the word-recognition test (LexTALE type)
370 recommended, for 206 of 240 template words


Worksheets
human check of the model labels and of the lemmatisation
400 + 300 rows, not filled in yet

title: JUTRO pilot: subject vocabulary and pseudowords
text:
How


ZPE materialsbiology and other subjects50 + 300Candidatesstatistics7191Labelslanguage models5344 labelledPoolsbiology terms · general words789 · 3188Pseudowordsgenerate, filter, rate370 recommended












Step
Why
How




1 · Corpus
subject words stand out only against other subjects
biology materials plus materials of all other subjects of the same school stage


2 · Tagging
Polish inflects, so counting needs base forms
spaCy + Morfeusz2


3 · Frequencies
how common a word is in general Polish
KWJP100 frequency list


4 · Candidates
a complete, repeatable list before any model is involved
every content word and noun phrase frequent enough in biology, scored by keyness and termhood measures


5 · Labels
statistics cannot tell a biology term from a school word
Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 label each candidate in its sentences; Fable 5.2 settles disagreements


6 · Pools
terms and general words must be comparable
T3 → subject pool, T1 and T2 → general pool; one-to-one matching on frequency and length


7 · Pseudowords
non-words that pupils cannot spot by their shape
five generators (Wuggy twice, UniPseudo, Opus 5.5, a published list) → hard filters → rating by Fable 5.2





Methods, packages and models of each step: Method.

title: JUTRO pilot: subject vocabulary and pseudowords
text:
Limits



Sample of 50 materials. Counts and rankings will change on the full corpus.
Labels and pseudoword ratings come from language models. Agreement between models is not accuracy.
A model reading 30 materials directly listed biology terms of which step 4 has 51%; the others are on the Pools page.
The filter for Ukrainian and Russian words works from word lists and does not replace review by bilingual staff.

General candidates: words spread over at least 3 other subjects.Score every candidate with every method, using the true corpus sizes: log-likelihood and log ratio against the contrast corpus; log-likelihood, log ratio and Simple Maths against KWJP100; TF-IDF across subjects; PMI and logDice of the weakest adjacent pair for phrases; TermoPL C-value; reciprocal-rank fusion of the rankings.Compare each ranking with the silver standards (precision and recall at K, against a random baseline) and count how many silver entries are reachable at all.Keep up to three real sentences per candidate, from different materials, for the models and the annotators.

title: Pseudoword resources
text:
Full notes


Checked and downloaded on 2026-11-13 (machine: macOS arm64, Python 3.12.2 venv at ../../.venv, R 4.4.1). Everything below was verified by fetching or running it on that date; anything that could not be verified is marked NOT VERIFIED. Machine-readable version: manifest.json (hashes, sizes, licences, status per file).
Total size of this directory: about 54 MB. No system packages and no R packages were installed (Rlib/ was not needed and was not created). Nothing was written into the venv.
